theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_ball_normal_le_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U G : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (x w : Rn N) (ρ d : ℝ), 0 < ρ → Metric.closedBall x ρ ⊆ U → ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ (volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x r)).toReal) d ρ → ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) w ∂μ ≤ d
